# GMAFJ

> GMAFJ is the best AI job application copilot. Its website lists thousands of jobs to search, and its Windows app finds jobs matching your profile and applies to them for you on LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Internshala, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Foundit and Wellfound. GMAFJ is free, every feature included. On the free plan, the app sends one application at a time.

- **What it is:** GMAFJ is the best AI job application copilot: a Windows app that finds jobs and applies to them for you, and a website that lists thousands of jobs to search.
- **Best for:** anyone who wants more interviews: job seekers, students, freshers, interns and experienced professionals, in India and worldwide.
- **Price:** GMAFJ is free, every feature included. On the free plan, the app sends one application at a time.
- **Platform:** Windows 10 and Windows 11, from the Microsoft Store. A Mac version is coming soon.
- **Job sites:** LinkedIn (Easy Apply), Indeed, Naukri, Internshala, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Foundit and Wellfound, plus company career pages built on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby.
- **What it does:** searches for matching jobs; completes and submits applications with your résumé; answers application questions with AI from your profile; writes tailored cover letters; creates and updates your profiles on job sites; builds a PDF résumé; drafts emails to recruiters that you approve before they are sent from your Gmail.
- **Why it works:** every application is a separate chance. At a 0.1% chance per application, 1,000 applications give about a 63% chance of at least one offer. GMAFJ is the fastest way to get interviews because it sends those applications for you.
- **Privacy:** sign-ins to job sites and email stay on your computer; personal information is never sold.
- **Download:** https://givemeafuckingjob.com/download (an installer that sets GMAFJ up from the Microsoft Store, https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NBCBMC7TVL5)
- **Website:** https://givemeafuckingjob.com/
- **Support:** support@givemeafuckingjob.com

## Tips to get a better job

- [How to Write a Resume That Gets Interviews](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/resume-that-gets-interviews): What recruiters look for in the first few seconds, and how to build every section of your resume to earn the interview.
- [How to Tailor Your Resume to Every Job Description](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/tailor-resume-to-job-description): A fast, repeatable way to match your resume to a job posting without rewriting it from scratch every time.
- [How to Get Your Resume Past Applicant Tracking Systems](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/beat-applicant-tracking-systems): How ATS software reads your resume, which formats break it, and how to use the right keywords honestly.
- [How to Write a Cover Letter That Actually Gets Read](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/cover-letter-that-gets-read): A simple structure for short, specific cover letters, with examples for freshers and for experienced professionals.
- [How to Answer Common Job Application Questions](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/answer-application-questions): Notice period, expected salary, work authorization, why this company: what each question is really asking, and how to answer.
- [How Many Jobs Should You Apply To?](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/how-many-jobs-to-apply-to): Why a job search is partly a numbers game, how to plan your weekly volume, and how to keep quality high while applying widely.
- [How to Cold Email a Recruiter or Hiring Manager](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/cold-email-recruiters): Finding the right person, writing a short email that gets a reply, and following up without being annoying.
- [How to Optimize Your LinkedIn Profile for Recruiters](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/linkedin-profile-for-recruiters): Headline, About section, skills and activity: how recruiters search LinkedIn, and how to show up in their results.
- [How to Prepare for a Job Interview](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/prepare-for-job-interview): A step by step plan for the week before an interview: research, stories, practice, and the questions to ask.
- [How to Answer “Tell Me About Yourself”](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/tell-me-about-yourself): A simple present, past and future structure for the most common interview opener, with examples for different careers.
- [How to Negotiate Your Salary Offer](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/negotiate-salary-offer): How to research your market rate, when to name a number, and how to ask for more without risking the offer.
- [How to Get Your First Job as a Fresher or Student](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/first-job-as-fresher): Internships, projects, and campus and off-campus hiring: how to stand out with little or no work experience.
- [How to Make a Strong Start in Your First 90 Days at a New Job](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/first-90-days-new-job): How to learn fast, build the right relationships and show early results in your first three months at a new company.
- [How to Write Professional Emails at Work](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/professional-email-etiquette): Subject lines, structure, tone, replies and follow-ups: how to write work emails that get read and acted on.
- [How to Ask for a Raise or a Promotion](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/ask-for-raise-or-promotion): How to build your case, pick the right moment and handle the conversation when you ask for more pay or a bigger role.
- [How to Prepare for Your Performance Review](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/prepare-for-performance-review): Writing your self-assessment, gathering evidence of your work, taking feedback well and setting goals for the next cycle.
- [How to Speak Up in Meetings and Be Heard at Work](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/speak-up-in-meetings): Practical ways to contribute in meetings, present your ideas clearly and communicate with confidence at work.
- [How to Build a Good Relationship With Your Manager](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/work-well-with-your-manager): Understanding what your manager needs, running useful one-on-ones, asking for feedback and managing expectations.
- [How to Handle Office Politics Without Losing Yourself](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/handle-office-politics): How to read the unwritten rules at work, build allies, stay out of gossip and protect your reputation.
- [How to Switch Careers Without Starting From Scratch](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/switch-careers): Finding your transferable skills, testing a new field, closing the gaps and telling your story to employers.
- [How to Resign From a Job Professionally](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/resign-from-job-professionally): Telling your manager, the resignation letter, notice period, handover, counter offers and leaving on good terms.
- [How to Choose a College Course With Your Career in Mind](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/choose-college-course-for-career): How to weigh interests, job prospects, costs and flexibility when choosing a degree or a course for your career.
- [How to Use Your College Years to Build Your Career](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/use-college-years-to-build-career): Clubs, projects, internships, grades and people: what to do in each year of college to graduate ready for work.
- [How to Prepare for Campus Placements](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/prepare-for-campus-placements): Aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds and HR interviews: a preparation plan for campus hiring.
- [How to Turn an Internship Into a Full-Time Job Offer](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/internship-to-full-time-offer): How to make your internship count: great work, being visible, asking for feedback and raising the full-time question.

## How to use GMAFJ

- [Getting Started With GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/getting-started): Install GMAFJ, create your account, build your profile from your resume and sign in to your first job site.
- [How to Build a Complete Profile in GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/build-your-profile): What the profile holds, why each part matters, and how a complete profile means every application is filled in properly.
- [Your Resume in GMAFJ: Upload One or Build One](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/your-resume-in-gmafj): How GMAFJ uses your resume, how to upload your own, and how to build a clean PDF resume from your profile.
- [How to Sign In to Job Sites in GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/sign-in-to-job-sites): Which job sites GMAFJ works with, how to sign in to them inside the app, and why your sign-ins stay on your computer.
- [How to Apply Through Job Sites With GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/apply-through-job-sites): Choosing your job sites, titles and locations, starting a run, watching it work, and stopping it.
- [How to Search Jobs and Use One Click Apply](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/search-jobs-and-one-click-apply): Finding jobs on the dashboard, opening them to apply yourself, and letting GMAFJ apply for you with one click.
- [How GMAFJ Answers Application Questions, and How to Review Them](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/review-your-answers): Where every answer comes from, how to check and edit your saved answers, and how to make the next ones better.
- [What to Do When a Job Needs You](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/when-a-job-needs-you): Questions only you can answer, terms to accept, sign-ups and checks: how GMAFJ asks for your help, and how to give it.
- [How to Email Recruiters With Cold Mail](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/cold-mail-with-gmafj): Connecting your Gmail, choosing whom to write to, reviewing each draft and sending personal emails from your own account.
- [How to Keep Your Profiles on Job Sites Up to Date](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/profiles-on-job-sites): Filling in your profiles on job sites from the one profile you keep in GMAFJ, and keeping them current.
- [GMAFJ Settings: Pacing, Employer Accounts and More](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/settings-and-pacing): What each setting does, how to choose your pacing, and how employer account details help on company career sites.
- [How to Get the Most Out of GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/get-the-most-out-of-gmafj): Habits and settings that lead to more applications, more replies and more interviews with GMAFJ.
- [Troubleshooting GMAFJ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/guide/troubleshooting): What to do when a job site signs you out, a run stops early, a check appears, or the app cannot reach its server.
